commitResults.messageTitle: Add view command and complete student profile display
commitResults.messageBody:
Add view EMAIL, which selects one student by canonical NUS email across
the complete roster. It keeps the current results when the target is
displayed and otherwise reveals the full sorted roster. The command is
read-only and reports its own retry message when display fails.

Show the selected student's complete profile beside the student list,
including every enrolment in display order, and list enrolments on each
result card. Both panels are prepared off-scene and replaced together,
so a failed display restores the previous list and profile.
